notes: Explicit demonstration configuration for the mobile-UE viewer check. Scenario alias 'base' constructs envs.pettingzoo.relay.forced_relay.UAVForcedRelayEnv behind ParallelToArrayAdapter; it is NOT routed_core. Every override below is an engineering choice made so that six UAVs can reach three moving UE clusters inside a short episode on a laptop. None of it is calibrated, and none of it is evidence about any algorithm. The UEs move because the environment's own RPGM mobility model moves them at user_max_speed; no motion is added by the viewer.

parameter_provenance.area_size: engineering_assumption: shrunk from the 8000 m default so the fleet reaches the UE clusters within a demonstration-length episode
parameter_provenance.n_users: engineering_assumption: fewer UEs keep the scene legible and the frame under the byte budget
parameter_provenance.episode_length: engineering_assumption: demonstration length, not an evaluation horizon
parameter_provenance.user_movement_model: environment default (rpgm); kept so UE motion is the environment's own
parameter_provenance.min_sinr: environment default; deliberately NOT altered, see the finding on base_to_uav_sinr

known_limitations: uav_bs_connections is identically False on this scenario because the modelled base-to-UAV SINR is about 146 dB below the UAV-to-base SINR at the same path loss. See docs/Claude_docs/findings/2026-09-18-forced-relay-downlink-sinr-and-dead-backhaul-adjacency.md. The scene therefore reports the SINR adjacency and the widest-path route as two separate criteria and counts their disagreement; it does not pick one and present it as the backhaul truth.
This environment has no traffic-demand model. Offered and delivered Mbps are reported as not applicable and are never drawn as zero.
There is no skill layer on this route, so no skill raster is produced and none is invented.
The per-agent local observation is not exposed through the adapter's state_info, so the policy-visible panel reports that it was not reconstructed rather than showing simulator truth in its place.
